_doc: Gabriel voice cast (docs/gabriel/VOICE.md). Schema: tools/story/voice.py docstring; breaths, pitch pinning (f0Hz): tools/story/voice_extras.py; timbre pinning (mfccRef) and the clean-voice floor (hnrMin): tools/story/voice_gabriel.py.

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈在床边给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
narrator.why: the storyteller of Esther, Ruth, Exodus, Prodigal and Daniel (Qwen vivian): the family's narrator across packs

gabriel.design: 男性，二十八岁左右，高大的年轻人。醇厚、温暖、有磁性的男中音，声音干净明亮、不沙哑，阳光、真诚、爱笑，像英雄大哥哥蹲下来轻声跟小朋友说话，绝不吼叫。普通话标准。
gabriel.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
gabriel.why: VoiceDesign young warm baritone (audition E seed 1: 139-189 Hz, HNR 9.3, CER 0.04); pinned 130-172 Hz so he stays one man and stays above Daniel (105 Hz). Not uncle_fu (three kings / fathers), not Daniel's design; eric misreads the name (加倍力); the edge voices read flat

narrator.why: the narrator of every pack, phrased

gabriel.design: Male, about thirty, a young warrior. A low-pitched, deep, warm baritone with a full chest, clean and steady, never husky; noble and strong, he smiles as he speaks and is very gentle with little children; never shouting.
gabriel.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, not overacted, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. This line:
gabriel.why: VoiceDesign warm baritone (audition C: 110-162 / 117-136 / 110-138 Hz on three seeds, HNR 11-14, WER 0): the only designed voice that stayed in one register on every seed; pinned 105-150 Hz. Not ryan (Daniel), not William (kings, God), not Andrew / Brian (Boaz, the brothers)

ga_01.m: 轻轻的、带着惊叹，像打开一个宝盒；慢一点；说到“加百列”时带着微笑
ga_01.m_en: hushed wonder, like opening a treasure box; slow; a smile on the name 'Gabriel'
ga_01.d: 画面：睡前，你指着窗外的星星，小声告诉孩子天上有什么。
ga_01.d_en: Picture: bedtime; you point at the stars and tell the child in a low voice what is up there.

phrases.text: there is a city full of light,
One of them is a great archangel.

ga_02.m: 温暖、有力量又温柔，像大哥哥蹲下来对小朋友说话；声音里带着微笑；说自己名字时带着安静的喜乐
ga_02.m_en: warm, strong and gentle at once, a big brother kneeling down to a small child; a smile in the voice; the name said with quiet joy
ga_02.d: 画面：你蹲下来，平视一个有点害怕的小朋友，对他笑。
ga_02.d_en: Picture: you kneel down to the eye level of a slightly scared child and smile.
